groups.defect: The isAccessTokenId matcher in AssertEvents reads the grant shortcut with substring(3,5) instead of substring(4,6) and inverts the equality check, so it never validates the grant type.

answer.reasoning: All nine suggestions report the same wrong offset and inverted comparison in the isAccessTokenId matcher, lines 480-484 of AssertEvents.java. s_a2208ca1 gives only the short filename but describes the identical defect. s_15c59a87 also flags the misleading code comment, but that comment describes the same offset error and is fixed by the same edit at the same place. The length check (items[0].length() == 6) appears only in proposed fixes, so it does not count as an extra defect. One edit resolves the whole group, so needsUnifiedComment is false.
